## Description

**What**: Verify that the AWS account (820258254566) with IAM credentials is accessible and functional for deploying the telemetry infrastructure.
**Why**: All AWS infrastructure provisioning for this epic (Lambda, S3, IAM role, CloudWatch) requires live AWS credentials. This is a prerequisite for every infrastructure setup story.
**Scope**:
- IN: Running aws sts get-caller-identity and confirming the account is accessible with the expected identity.
- OUT: Provisioning any AWS resources (handled by downstream stories).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, `aws sts get-caller-identity` exits 0 and returns the expected account ID 820258254566.
  ← Satisfies: sc-1  (sc-1: "After running aws-setup-bucket.sh && aws-setup-lambda.sh, the following resources exist and pass an idempotency check")

## Considerations

- [Reliability] AWS credentials must be available in the sprint environment before infrastructure setup stories begin.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: Verify and integrate AWS account with IAM credentials (account 820258254566)
